bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus"
systemctl --user stop gace-userbot-verify.service
trap 'systemctl --user start gace-userbot-verify.service || true' EXIT
cd "$root"
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from telethon import TelegramClient
from scripts.userbot_session import load_credentials,SESSION_BASE
async def main():
    api_id,api_hash=load_credentials()
    async with TelegramClient(str(SESSION_BASE),api_id,api_hash) as c:
        assert await c.is_user_authorized(),"USERBOT_NOT_AUTHORIZED"
        bot=await c.get_entity("GayBBS_bot")
        msgs=await c.get_messages(bot,limit=15)
        menu=next((m for m in msgs if not m.out and m.buttons and any(b.text=="募集+Room" for row in m.buttons for b in row)),None)
        assert menu is not None,"APPROVED_POSTING_MENU_NOT_FOUND"
        try:
            await menu.click(text="募集+Room")
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
            responses=await c.get_messages(bot,limit=8)
            screens=[m for m in responses if not m.out]
            assert screens,"ROOM_SCREEN_NOT_RETURNED"
            found=False;blocked=False
            for m in screens:
                labels=[b.text for row in (m.buttons or []) for b in row]
                if "Room作成" in labels and "Room持ち込み" in labels:
                    found=True;screen=m
                    break
                if "準備中" in (m.raw_text or "") or "現在利用できません" in (m.raw_text or ""):blocked=True
            if blocked and not found:raise RuntimeError("ROOM_BUTTON_BLOCKED_BY_FEATURE_GATE")
            assert found,"ROOM_METHOD_PICKER_NOT_VISIBLE"
            print("USERBOT_REAL_ROOM_ENTRY_PASS")
            await screen.click(text="キャンセル")
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            print("USERBOT_ROOM_CANCEL_SENT")
        except Exception as e:
            print("ROOM_ENTRY_EXCEPTION_TYPE="+type(e).__name__)
            raise
asyncio.run(main())
PY
